subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] 按用户维度统计 Token 使用量

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class per-user token accounting to core usage surfaces, and what identity, authorization, retention, and quota/billing model should it use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested feature changes identity, privacy, storage, authorization, and operator billing semantics rather than repairing broken existing behavior.

options.title: Sponsor a core design first
options.body: Define the identity source, authorized readers, storage schema, aggregation RPCs, Dashboard and `/usage` behavior, and privacy/retention rules before implementation.

options.title: Keep user billing external
options.body: Use current session/agent/channel/model usage surfaces plus Prometheus, plugins, or external tooling until OpenClaw has a stronger multi-user accounting model.

options.title: Narrow to existing aggregates
options.body: Split any remaining work into smaller session, agent, or model usage improvements and leave per-user quotas out of scope for now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a core design first
recommendation.body: Define the identity source, authorized readers, storage schema, aggregation RPCs, Dashboard and `/usage` behavior, and privacy/retention rules before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest product-surface history is the `/usage` cost-summary and usage-infrastructure work in commit 3ce1ee84, which is central to the requested command and billing path.
